title: Terrestrial Biomes
description: The major land biomes with their climate, rainfall, and typical vegetation.

results.name: Tropical Rainforest
results.example_regions: Amazon Basin, Congo Basin, Southeast Asia
results.dominant_vegetation: Dense broadleaf evergreen trees with layered canopy.

results.name: Tropical Savanna
results.climate: Warm with distinct wet and dry seasons

results.name: Desert
results.climate: Very hot or cold with extreme aridity
results.dominant_vegetation: Sparse succulents, cacti, and hardy shrubs.

results.name: Temperate Grassland
results.climate: Warm summers and cold winters, semi-arid
results.example_regions: North American prairies, Eurasian steppe, pampas
results.dominant_vegetation: Grasses and herbaceous plants with few trees.

results.name: Temperate Deciduous Forest
results.climate: Four distinct seasons with moderate rainfall
results.example_regions: Eastern North America, Western Europe, East Asia
results.dominant_vegetation: Broadleaf trees that shed leaves in autumn.

results.name: Mediterranean (Chaparral)
results.climate: Hot dry summers and mild wet winters
results.dominant_vegetation: Drought-resistant evergreen shrubs and small trees.

results.name: Taiga (Boreal Forest)
results.climate: Long cold winters and short cool summers
results.dominant_vegetation: Coniferous evergreen trees like spruce, fir, and pine.

results.name: Tundra
results.climate: Extremely cold with permafrost and short growing season
results.example_regions: Arctic Circle, alpine peaks, northern Alaska
results.dominant_vegetation: Mosses, lichens, sedges, and dwarf shrubs.

results.name: Temperate Rainforest
results.climate: Cool, wet, and mild with high humidity
results.example_regions: Pacific Northwest, southern Chile, New Zealand
results.dominant_vegetation: Towering conifers with dense ferns and mosses.

results.name: Montane (Alpine)
results.dominant_vegetation: Zoned vegetation from forest to alpine meadow and bare rock.

results.name: Mangrove
results.example_regions: Sundarbans, Florida Everglades, Southeast Asian coasts
results.dominant_vegetation: Salt-tolerant mangrove trees with stilt roots.

results.name: Wetland
results.dominant_vegetation: Reeds, sedges, grasses, and water-tolerant plants.
